name: dsh-pocket-glide
description: Pocket DSH — the light mobile companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Pair by QR, then tap a push notification to jump straight back in: instant open, optimistic sends, smooth streaming, permission approvals and queued prompts on the go — plus a full phone window onto your DS Bot team (member chats, group rooms, tool approvals). Runs in-process, dials out via a Cloudflare quick tunnel that heals itself after a restart.
